name: clock_gettime
description: The clock_gettime() function retrieves the current time of the specified clock and stores it in the timespec structure pointed to by tp. The clockid argument identifies the clock to query, which may be system-wide or per-process.

parameters.name: clockid
parameters.description: Identifier of the clock to retrieve the time from, such as CLOCK_REALTIME.

parameters.name: tp
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure where the retrieved time is stored.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: tp points outside the accessible address space.
The device represented by the dynamic clock ID has disappeared.
The operation is not supported by the dynamic clock device.
The timestamp would not fit in time_t range.
